parts.name: Frosted tube
parts.notes: 2447 white translucent extruded acrylic tube, 2.000" OD x 1.750" ID x 72", ordered with cutting to 4.000" pieces. Not on Amazon in a translucent grade. Sold only as a full 6 ft stick: $145.63 + $20 cutting = $165.63, which makes 17 tubes, so $9.75 each across a batch of 17. A one-off build still pays for the whole stick.

parts.name: ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker, OV2640) + ESP32-CAM-MB programmer
parts.notes: 1 pc ESP32-CAM + ESP32-CAM-MB (CH340G, micro-USB) + OV2640. AI-Thinker pin map. Board 27 x 40.5 x 4.5 mm (Ai-Thinker datasheet).

parts.name: WS2812B 12-LED ring
parts.notes: DIYmall 12-bit WS2812B ring, 37 mm OD / 23 mm ID, 4-7 V. No leads: solder 3 wires.

parts.name: Micro-USB panel extension
parts.notes: zdyCGTime 30 cm micro-USB male to micro-USB female panel-mount cable with screw ears, data + power. The flange drops into the slot in the base (no ear screws). Flange size estimated at 33 x 9.6 x 2 mm: check it before printing.

parts.name: 5 V 2 A USB wall adapter + micro-USB cable
parts.notes: UL-listed 5V 2A USB charger with a 1.5 m micro-USB data cable. Search: "5V 2A micro USB charger UL listed".

parts.name: 220 ohm resistor
parts.notes: Status LED series resistor, 1/4 W. Search: "resistor assortment kit 1/4W".

parts.name: 330 ohm resistor
parts.notes: In series with the ring's data line, same assortment kit.

parts.name: PTC resettable fuse 0.5 A
parts.notes: Radial polyfuse, 0.5 A hold, in the ring's 5 V lead. Search: "PTC resettable fuse assortment".

parts.name: Silicone hook-up wire 26 AWG + heat-shrink
parts.notes: About 40 cm total for the ring and LED leads. Search: "26 AWG silicone wire kit".

parts.name: Rubber bumper feet 8 mm
parts.notes: Clear self-adhesive 8 x 2.5 mm bumpers, in the 1 mm recesses under the base. Search: "clear rubber bumper feet 8mm".

parts.name: M2×6 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M2 x 6mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

parts.name: M3×12 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M3 x 12mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

soldering_reason: The LED ring, status LED, resistors and fuse are wired to the ESP32-CAM's header pins with 8 small solder joints.
